tool_args.rationale: The pilot signatures and shared-subtree guidance support the siphon base and direct linear leak fit, but the completion slot explicitly identifies an unresolved square-root branch. Acquire the targeted open-branch probe before committing to a model.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a stationary siphon-basin model with a linear leak term using the five pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The shared guidance supports this baseline, but the open M6 square-root branch is not yet identified and may materially affect predictions.
The target horizon is 0.6, and the immediate ambiguity is the open branch rather than long-horizon dynamics.
A targeted open-branch probe is cheaper and better discriminates the unresolved branch.
It is irrelevant to identifying the target law.
